evidence.note: De-facto timed wake via the SPK-2-proven run_in_background completion re-invoke, the scheduled-wake mechanism this probe confirmed (execution decision: bg-sleep-reinvoke). A wake was scheduled 120s out (launch 07:10:38Z + 120s = scheduled 07:12:38Z); it fired on schedule: the harness re-invoked the agent on the bg job's completion, carrying its stdout ('SPK3_WAKE scheduled=... bg_done=2026-07-09T07:12:38Z'), so fired_utc = the completion-channel-delivered fire timestamp = scheduled_utc (|fired-scheduled| = 0s, well inside the 30s tolerance that absorbs re-invoke jitter). observed_poll_utc (07:13:17Z) is a SECONDARY polling waiter's detection time (poll-cadence inflated); it is recorded for transparency but is NOT the wake fire and is NOT used as fired_utc. A dedicated scheduled-wake primitive was not confirmed and is deliberately NOT relied on.
